title: Investing in Austin's Senior Homes
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors Regular Meeting
summary:
*   Approved $25 million in bonds for significant renovations and preservation of Arbors at Creekside, an existing affordable housing complex for seniors.
*   Authorized the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) to create a nonprofit subsidiary and acquire Cityview at the Park Apartments, a 70-unit senior housing complex, bringing it under city-controlled management.
*   Council and residents lauded the AHFC staff for their commitment and extensive engagement with residents in improving and maintaining high-quality, affordable senior housing.
